content: On the frozen low-texture wrist fixture ROI, LoFTR indoor + RANSAC + ECC passed only 1/4 known-image-warp tests, no improvement in pass count over LoFTR + RANSAC; ECC score up to 0.9993 coexisted with mapping error. Do not promote this configuration from match count or correlation alone.
applicability: This archived wrist RGB ROI and fixed software-design transforms; not a universal LoFTR or RGB limitation
count_semantics: Four image-warp software checks, not robot tasks
limitations: One source image, small transform set
Different runtime builds across extractors; cost not a fair speed benchmark
No real camera or physical parameter fit
